user.title: Dashboard MCP for Morgan
user.description: Select the dashboards Morgan may query. The MCP endpoint is /api/mcp/dashboard_mcp. No dashboards are exposed by default.

data.include_condition_states: Allow read-only access to condition helpers
data.viewer_user_id: Dashboard viewer user ID (optional; blank means unknown)
data.keep_image_paths: Keep image URLs in information records

data_description.dashboards: Only selected dashboards can be searched or read. New dashboards are not added automatically.
data_description.blocked_entities: Matching references are replaced with [REDACTED_ENTITY]. Their states are never returned.
data_description.mode: Dumb evaluates conditions in the integration. Smart returns conditions for the agent to evaluate.
data_description.include_condition_states: Permit reading helpers referenced by conditions, even if they are not a displayed control. Does not permit changing them.
data_description.extra_read_entities: Explicit read access regardless of dashboard conditions. Entity redaction still overrides it.
data_description.viewer_user_id: Used only for user visibility conditions. Do not enter the MCP administrator ID unless it really is the intended dashboard viewer.
data_description.enable_yaml_export: Returns resolved YAML with redaction. Disabled in dumb mode to prevent bypassing evaluated restrictions.
data_description.semantic_search: Embeds selected catalogue text using your configured endpoint. Keyword search remains available during indexing.
data_description.embedding_model: Exact model identifier registered in LocalAI. Changing the model or endpoint rebuilds the index.
data_description.embedding_batch_size: Documents per request, 1–64. Reduce if LocalAI runs out of memory.
data_description.embedding_min_similarity: Semantic match cutoff from -1 to 1. Default 0.45 is a starting point; calibrate with your model and catalogue.
